profile.headline: Senior Principal Software Engineer at The Home Depot
profile.summary: Seasoned Applied AI Scientist and Engineer with 9 years of industry experience spanning precision clinical diagnostics, petabyte-scale production machine learning systems, and fundamental research in machine learning and AI. Currently a Senior Principal Software Engineer driving AI strategy and technical direction across a portfolio of engineering teams at The Home Depot, architecting reusable foundational systems, piloting emerging AI technologies, and optimizing cloud resource efficiency. Track record of translating advanced research into high-impact production systems, mentoring technical teams, and building scalable AI platforms. More than 50 peer reviewed publications and several issued and provisional patents.

positions.title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Core AI Team
• Provide technical leadership and AI strategy across a portfolio of engineering teams, architecting reusable foundational systems, piloting emerging AI technologies, and driving cloud cost optimization initiatives.

positions.title: Applied Scientist II
positions.description:
• ML/AI technical authority responsible for establishing AI strategy, mentoring engineering, product, and data teams, and defining AI and ML technical standards across an organization in Amazon Devices.
• Architected and deployed autonomous agentic systems using foundation models and LLMs, enabling real-time decision-making across petabyte-scale datasets with 99.9% uptime, improving critical business metrics by 20-30%.
• Led cross-functional initiatives with product, engineering, and leadership teams to identify high-impact AI opportunities; defined roadmap for next-generation observability and predictive analytics capabilities.
positions.insights: Skills: Generative AI · Large Language Models (LLM) · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Applied Machine Learning · Artificial Intelligence (AI)

positions.title: Senior Bioinformatics Data Scientist
positions.description:
• Led ML product development from ideation to clinical deployment; mentored junior data scientists and collaborated with clinical, regulatory, and product teams to translate algorithmic innovations into FDA-relevant diagnostics.
• Architected explainable machine learning classifiers for disease diagnostics, achieving company’s first clinically performant cancer detection models; secured stakeholder buy-in through rigorous validation and interpretability analysis.
• Fundamentally reworked proteomic assay signal statistical representation and implemented novel renormalization techniques, reducing technical variation by 5-10x while improving interpretability; published methodology and established new standards for team.
positions.insights: Skills: Applied Machine Learning · Large Language Models (LLM) · Bioinformatics · Proteomics · Computational Biology

positions.title: Senior Data Scientist
positions.description:
• Led high-visibility COVID-19 prognosis prediction project as technical PM, securing executive sponsorship, coordinating with clinical collaborators at CU, and delivering validated machine learning decision support system (resulting in issued patent).
• Developed novel explainable AI methods for decision tree ensembles, delivering exact Shapley value calculations; mentored team on interpretable ML, published methodology (Machine Learning with Applications), and established interpretability as core competency.
• Established credibility with senior leadership; influenced company strategy toward explainable AI and won internal recognition award for COVID-19 work in 2021.
positions.insights: Skills: Applied Machine Learning · Deep Learning · Explainable AI · Biomarkers · Proteomics

positions.title: Postdoctoral Research Associate
positions.description:
• Conducted research on deep learning for particle identification in neutrino physics experiments; mentored CU graduate and undergraduate students on ML applications in physics.
• Served as reviewer for T2K and DUNE experiments, providing technical guidance on ML analysis standards and contributing to experimental rigor.
positions.insights: Skills: Neural Networks · Computer Vision · Applied Machine Learning · Statistics · Algorithm Design

positions.title: Data Scientist
positions.description: Developed and deployed machine learning methods for time series analysis in enterprise observability; built forecasting and anomaly detection pipelines serving thousands of customers at scale.
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Algorithm Design · Software Development · Deep Learning

positions.title: Graduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Primary focus was developing software for analyzing large data sets collected at the ND280 detector complex at the T2K neutrino oscillation experiment resulting in many publications.
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · High Performance Computing (HPC) · Statistics · C++ · Linux
